pages.title: Page Curve and Islands
pages.text: $(thing)Page Curve and Islands$()$(br2)The radiation's entropy rises as a black hole evaporates, then - after the Page time - falls back to zero: the information comes out. Islands inside the horizon, counted as part of the radiation, make it turn over.

$(thing)Insight$(): 340$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Information Paradox, ER = EPR.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Firewall Shard, 2 Soft Hair Filament, 1 ER Bridge Thread.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A black hole takes a time τ to evaporate from mass M to nothing, its remaining lifetime going as the cube of its mass. Write the time t it takes to shrink from M to m.
